latestVerifiedPriorRelease.evidenceScope: Externally verified prior production release. This receipt is committed only after GitHub, Vercel, live routes, and selected live bytes were verified. It does not attest to the commit that contains it or any future deployment.

releaseVerification.note: Build-time readiness and deployed-release evidence are separate. A committed artifact cannot attest to a future deployment of its own commit.

national.applicabilityClassificationScope: Full-catalog state-species applicability only. Source applicability and bounded source screening remain separate.

measuredRateEvidence.confidenceQualification: The current FIA partition did not retain one durable end-to-end timer, so no national-source rate is claimed.

national.forecastQualification: No national certification date is defensible from the current measurements. The worker replay point estimate excludes acquisition, state-specific research, blocked geography, freshness review, integration, and production QA.

historicalPilotForecast.qualificationAtMeasurement: This is a capacity forecast for versioned automated national-source screens at the validated end-to-end pilot rate. It is not a national certification forecast because 47 jurisdictions remain applicability-unclassified and state, manual, blocked, and source-specific workloads are not yet measured.
historicalPilotForecast.note: The historical qualification is retained as dated evaluation evidence. Its 47-jurisdiction applicability statement is not a current fact.
